title: Mind the Gap: Navigating Inference with Optimal Transport Maps
abstract: arXiv:2507.08867v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) techniques have recently enabled enormous gains in sensitivity to new phenomena across the sciences. In particle physics, much of this progress has relied on excellent simulations of a wide range of physical processes. However, due to the sophistication of modern machine learning algorithms and their reliance on high-quality training samples, discrepancies between simulation and experimental data can significantly limit their effectiveness. In this work, we present a solution to this ``misspecification'' problem: a model calibration approach based on optimal transport, which we apply to high-dimensional simulations for the first time. We demonstrate the performance of our approach through jet tagging, using a dataset inspired by the CMS experiment at the Large Hadron Collider. translated_title: 注意间隙：利用最优传输映射进行推断导航
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）技术近来在科学领域对新现象的探测灵敏度方面带来了巨大的提升。在粒子物理学中，这些进展很大程度上依赖于对广泛物理过程的优质模拟。然而，由于现代机器学习算法的复杂性及其对高质量训练样本的依赖，模拟与实验数据之间的差异可能会显著限制它们的有效性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种解决这一“错误设定”问题的方案：一种基于最优传输的模型校准方法，并首次将其应用于高维模拟。我们通过喷注标记任务展示了该方法的表现，所使用的数据集受大型强子对撞机（LHC）CMS实验启发。我们研究了一个来自强大通用分类器的128维内部喷注表示；在对此内部表示进行校准之后……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于最优传输的模型校准方法，首次应用于高维模拟以解决粒子物理中机器学习面临的模拟与实验数据不一致问题，并通过喷注标记任务验证了其有效性。
